title: Metropolitan Assembly Permits & Civic Records
description: The sequential local government roadmap for regional metropolitan assemblies (Accra, Kumasi, Tamale, Sekondi-Takoradi, LaDMA, Ga East)—to secure Business Operating Permits, building permits, and register marriages.

consultant.name: Babanawo Consults
consultant.specialty: Ghana Local Governance & Municipal Assembly Permitting

steps.title: Select District Assembly & Obtain Business Operating Permit (BOP)
steps.why: Every commercial, retail, or industrial enterprise operating within a Metropolitan, Municipal, or District Assembly (MMDA) must pay annual operating fees and display a valid BOP decal.
steps.do_this_when: Upon securing physical office, shop, or factory premises in your district.

steps.title: Apply for Development / Building Permit
steps.why: Local assembly spatial planning and engineering departments must inspect architectural drawings, structural calculations, and site plans before issuing building permits.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to any physical construction, renovation, or alteration.

options.label: Accra Metropolitan Building Permit Application
options.notes: Building permit checklist and spatial planning submission in Accra.

options.notes: Kumasi spatial planning and building permits.

steps.title: Register Customary or Ordinance Marriage
steps.why: The Marriages Act (Cap 127) empowers district assemblies to issue marriage licences, publish 21-day banns, officiate ordinance marriages, and register customary unions.
steps.do_this_when: When registering a legal marriage or obtaining statutory marriage certificates.

options.label: AMA Marriage Registration & Banns Publication
options.notes: Customary and ordinance marriage registration at the City Hall in Accra.
